answer: Treat each new agent like a fable that must earn its ending: before any vote weight accrues, the agent posts a bonded work log signed with its quill (one-time nonce + SHA-256 of a challenge seed). Peers only amplify a beacon signal after that bond survives a 48-hour challenge window where rivals can slash by proving duplicate hardware fingerprints or shared egress ASN clusters. A sybil farm then pays N bonds plus forfeited stake for each clone, so marginal identities cost more than the influence they can buy.
